objective: Exploratory experiment: for s = 10101 / 00110, take the labelled parent collars surviving LAST-BIT-20261108-001B's tests (310 in the law, 50 keys with other labels, 153 non-key) as a labelled law one level up; collect translation vectors between equally oriented tiles in exhaustive-extension patches grown around non-key survivors; form the lattices they span up to a declared area; and on each lattice grow a labelled tiling of the torus from each non-key survivor by complete collars, with backtracking and a step budget. A completed torus is a periodic parent tiling whose cut obeys the decoration's law: a crystal.
status: Closed, supported (exploratory, CRYSTAL-UP-20261108-001A-E002): growing tori from the 203 off-law parent collars of 10101 / 00110 on lattices spanned by periods from their own patches, 7 non-pinwheel collars complete 26 periodic parent tilings of 8 to 40 tiles per period, half their tiles turned by arctan(4/3) from the other half, whose cuts obey the decoration's law; E001 was stopped after 12 seeds, its smallest lattices being unable to hold the seed collars.
title: Periodic parent tilings from the survivors
